description:
What's New in v1.0.3 🚀

High-Quality Audio Downloading: Added support for extracting and downloading YouTube videos directly as high-quality MP3 audio files.

Fixed YouTube Download Failures (HTTP 403 / Stalls): Implemented an automated background update engine for the core yt-dlp library to ensure smooth, uninterrupted YouTube downloads.

Auto-Play / Open File Fix: Resolved an issue where downloaded audio or video files failed to launch or play automatically right after completion.

Performance & Stability Enhancements: Smoother installation process and minor UI responsiveness improvements.
